Fix Issue https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/63977.
'repeat' key within self._variables does not exist for repeat configuration with loop count of 0. 
Based on this the key cannot be deleted and causes an error.
Checking if self._variable['repeat'] exists previously to deleting - if it does not exist write only a warning into logs.

issue_context.title: script / automation repeat with count 0 fails
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When _repeat_ within a script or automation is executed with a **count of 0** (which might happen when count is provided by templates) it fails with the errors visible in logs below.
I would expect the repeat part to be not executed/skipped fully without any error (or just a warning into the logs) - which was the case in past releases as far as I know.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.12.9

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

### Integration causing the issue

Scripts

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/docs/scripts/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
- id: test_automation
    alias: test_automation
    description: 'Any test automation'
    mode: parallel
    trigger:
      - id: 'bool_on' 
        platform: state
        entity_id: input_boolean.test_input_boolean
        to: 'on'
    action:         
      - alias: 'test loop1'
        repeat: 
          count: 3
          sequence:
            - service: system_log.write
              data_template:
                message: "in loop1 - repeat: {{repeat.index}} - This should be fine (verify no issue with count > 1)"                
                logger: homeassistant.components.automation.test_automation
                level: Info
      - alias: 'test loop2'
        repeat: 
          count: 1
          sequence:
            - service: system_log.write
              data_template:
                message: "in loop2 - repeat: {{repeat.index}} - This should be fine (verify no issue with count == 1)"                
                logger: homeassistant.components.automation.test_automation
                level: Info
      - alias: 'test loop3'
        repeat: 
          count: 0
          sequence:
            - service: system_log.write
              data_template:
                message: "in loop3 - repeat: {{repeat.index}} - Here we fail (issue with count == 0)"                
                logger: homeassistant.components.automation.test_automation
                level: critical                 
      - service: system_log.write
        data_template:
          message: "Automation - completed"                
          logger: homeassistant.components.automation.test_automation
          level: critical
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2022-01-12 14:43:34 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.automation.test_automation] test_automation: Error executing script. Unexpected error for repeat at pos 4: 'repeat'
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/script.py", line 381, in _async_step
await getattr(self, handler)()
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/trace.py", line 251, in async_wrapper
await func(*args)
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/script.py", line 752, in _async_repeat_step
del self._variables["repeat"]
KeyError: 'repeat'
2022-01-12 14:43:34 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.automation.test_automation] While executing automation automation.test_automation
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/automation/__init__.py", line 508, in async_trigger
await self.action_script.async_run(
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/script.py", line 1260, in async_run
await asyncio.shield(run.async_run())
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/script.py", line 363, in async_run
await self._async_step(log_exceptions=False)
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/script.py", line 381, in _async_step
await getattr(self, handler)()
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/trace.py", line 251, in async_wrapper
await func(*args)
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/script.py", line 752, in _async_repeat_step
del self._variables["repeat"]
KeyError: 'repeat'
```


### Additional information

I have seen this error after 2021-12-9 release upgrade... it might have happened earlier but I did not experience it.
At least based on the change log within 2021-12-3 there was a verification change of the repeat sequence included.
